test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: What will be the equivalent single discount for successive discounts of 15%, 20% and 24%?
solution:
Given:

The successive discounts of 15%, 20% and 24%.

Formula used:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

Where,

X = First discount

Y = Second discount

Calculation:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

X = 20%, Y = 15%

⇒ 20 + 15 - 300/100

⇒ 32%

Now,

⇒ 32 + 24 - (32 × 24)/100

⇒ 56 - 7.68

= 48.32%

∴ The single equivalent discount is 48.32%.
